text:
sana: Heads-up — bringing up Stargaze LoRA v1.2 on llama-13b-int4 in staging. quick evalpack shows invoice line-item truncation and currency token drift. will attach evalpack results.
matt: ack. paste the promptset?
sana: using promptset invoice-v2 (line_items + totals). cmd: `rwd-eval run --pack invoice-v2 --model llama-13b-int4 --adapter stargaze-lora-v1.2 --out /tmp/stargaze-eval.json`
eva: diff shows totals sometimes missing cents and currency symbol. looks quant-related. tokenizer mismatch?
matt: tokenizer check: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('llama-tokenizer.json').encode('€ 12.50'))"` tokens match.
oliver: infra-bot: smoke-test failed on node-3: OOM at step 42 (alloc 7.4GB). node-1 finished eval.
sana: customer uses formats like EUR:12.50 and inline linebreaks. suspect LoRA+kv-cache issue when quantized.
matt: sample outputs:
BASELINE: Line items:
- 1x Widget A — €12.50
- 3x Widget B — €37.50
TOTAL: €50.00

INT4+STARGAZE: Line items:
- 1x Widget A — 12
- 3x Widget B — 37
TOTAL: 49
eva: euro symbol and cents dropped. maybe embedding offset for currency token after quantization.
oliver: can we repro with qlora/4bit vs post-compile int4? try disabling kv-cache to see effect.
sana: plan: 1) serve with `--kv-cache=false` 2) evalpack with `--seed 42 --fewshots 0` 3) dump token logits for currency token ids and diff baseline.
matt: deploy started: host stg-small-7 image rwd-runtime:2026-03-22. log: `INFO model: loaded adapter stargaze-lora-v1.2; quant_mode=int4; kv_cache=disabled`. quick eval: cents preserved when kv_cache=false; with kv_cache=true cents dropped in ~28% of cases.
eva: confirms kv-cache interaction. hypothesis: adapter writes to early KV layers; quant rounding causes token id collisions.
sana: try adapter-scale 0.7 and per-channel quant rescale patch.
matt: adapter-scale 0.7 reduced failures to ~5%. attaching diffs.
oliver: filing ENG-RT-4123 to check embedding layout and kv offsets. also investigate why node-3 OOMed.
sana: customer next steps: 1) temporary canary with kv_cache disabled 2) propose adapter patch (rescale + token remap) 3) run deterministic 500-prompt sweep and share CSV mismatches.
matt: exported CSV: /artifacts/stargaze/1839990001/eval-500.csv (1.1MB).
infra-bot: artifact uploaded: /artifacts/stargaze/1839990001/eval-500.csv
sana: assign tasks — matt: canary kv_cache=false on dedicated nodes and measure perf; eva: open adapter patch PR and test; oliver: triage ENG-RT-4123 OOM/kernel selector.
matt: canary done — p50 latency +3% with kv_cache off; cents preserved. ETA for dedicated run ~2h earlier.
eva: PR up: stargaze/adapter-fix branch with unit test and reproducer.
oliver: checking kernel selector logs for layout mismatch between nodes. will update ticket.
sana: keep customer advised. recommend kv_cache=false as short-term mitigation until runtime fix and adapter patch validated. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: canary on s7 completed at 1839990123
